communities.name: Asian FX and Livestock and food

method: Graphical lasso (EBIC) with stability selection, pairwise LiNGAM orientation, structural VAR(1), Diebold-Yilmaz connectedness
findings: 72 monthly series and 28 judged concepts; 165 same-month links are selected in at least 70% of 60 half-samples. 60 are established (selected in 90% at a stricter penalty), with at most 5.8 expected false among them (Meinshausen-Buhlmann bound). Regressing each series on its parents keeps 116 with |t| >= 2 (49 removed), 48 of them established.
68% of them point the way their own pairwise evidence says; 21 links from one series to another next month pass |t| >= 2.5, and 52 series carry their own momentum.
System connectedness is 24%: the share of a typical series' 12-month forecast error that comes from other series' shocks.
Rolling 5-year connectedness peaked at 86% in 2011-08 and reads 81% now.
